title: Gucci Guilty £35, Philips i9000 shaver £199.99 and Lego Concorde £130
description: Wednesday's checked UK deals: Gucci Guilty for £35 and a Philips i9000 shaver at £199.99 from Boots, plus Lego Concorde for £130 and a Ninja air fryer at Argos.
intro:
**Today's standout is Gucci Guilty Pour Homme eau de toilette (50ml) for £35 at Boots, £41 off.** That's an easy Christmas present at under half its usual price. Boots has also cut the Philips i9000 Prestige shaver by £350 to £199.99, and Argos has Lego's Concorde down to £130 and a Ninja Foodi 4-in-1 air fryer at £99.99.

It's a short list of seven. Argos, Boots and several deal sites wouldn't let us check prices directly this morning, so every price here comes from T3's early Black Friday live blog, posted yesterday (3 November). Check the price at the till. Buy now or wait? The fragrance and the shaver are strong enough to buy now. The Lego sets are fair prices but often drop further nearer Black Friday, so wait if you're not in a hurry.

deals.name: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml
deals.note: A designer aftershave for £35 makes a ready-made present for a dad, partner or brother. Our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/) has more fragrance ideas, and gift sets with a shower gel thrown in are often only a few pounds more.

deals.name: Philips Shaver i9000 Prestige wet and dry electric shaver (XP9201/30)
deals.note: £350 off Philips' top rotary shaver, which adjusts to your skin and works in the shower. The £549.99 'was' is a list price that few people pay, but £199.99 is still a fair price for a flagship shaver.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi 4-in-1 air fryer
deals.note: £60 off a Ninja air fryer at Argos. Check the listing to confirm it's the basket size you want. Our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) has target prices for dual-basket models if you cook for a family.

deals.name: Garmin Index S2 Smart Scale, Black
deals.note: A modest £19 off, but it's a sensible add-on for anyone who already uses a Garmin watch, as weight and body composition sync straight into Garmin Connect. Not worth it if you just want a basic bathroom scale.

deals.name: LEGO Icons Concorde
deals.note: £40 off a big display set that adult Lego fans love. It's a decent price, but large Icons sets often get a bit cheaper on Black Friday, so only buy now if you're worried about stock. Our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) tracks the big sets.

deals.name: LEGO Italian Riviera
deals.note: £50 off a large adult build. A good present for a Lego fan who already has the vehicles and wants something different on the shelf.

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon
deals.note: £160 off Lego's giant collector's Falcon. That's a big saving in pounds, but at this price it's worth watching a little longer, as it's a set that gets discounted every Black Friday.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Not for the Gucci Guilty: £35 is less than half what it usually costs, and fragrance prices tend to rise again in December. The Philips i9000 is also a good price now. The Lego sets are the ones to think about. Argos usually runs more Lego offers through November, so unless you need to get it now, the Concorde and the Falcon are worth watching. Argos's main Black Friday event is covered in our [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/), and Black Friday itself is on 27 November. See [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for every retailer's dates.

## This week: Christmas beauty gift sets

Today's Gucci deal is a good fit for this week's spotlight, [Christmas beauty gift sets 2026: what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/christmas-beauty-gift-sets-2026/), which has target prices for gift sets and the Boots offers worth knowing about. Our [Boots Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/boots-black-friday-2026/) explains when Boots' biggest beauty discounts usually land.
